# xshield_fields (Data Source)

The searchable fields for a scope, which is the catalogue a criteria is written against.

Use this to discover which tag keys exist, which of them are core tags usable in a segment criteria, and the closed set of values an enumerated field accepts. This is the field catalogue, not the legacy custom tag list at `/api/tags`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Which tag keys exist, and which of them a segment criteria may use.
data "xshield_fields" "asset" {
  scope = "asset"
}

output "core_tags" {
  value = data.xshield_fields.asset.core_tag_names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `scope` (String) Limit the catalogue to one scope, for example `asset`, `path`, `port`, `template`, `namednetwork`, `tagrule` or `tagbasedpolicy`. Left unset, every field is returned. An unknown scope is rejected by the API.

### Read-Only

- `core_tag_names` (List of String) Internal names of the core tag fields, sorted. These are the fields a segment criteria may use.
- `fields` (Attributes List) Every field in the scope, ordered by internal name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields))
- `sortable_names` (List of String) Internal names of the fields that may appear in a sort, sorted.

<a id="nestedatt--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields`

Read-Only:

- `core_tag` (Boolean) True when the field is a core tag, the only kind a segment criteria may use.
- `data_type` (String) Value type, which decides how a literal is validated.
- `display_name` (String) Human readable name, which a criteria may also use when quoted.
- `facetable` (Boolean) True when the field may be summarised, which `xshield_field_values` requires.
- `internal_name` (String) Name to use in a criteria. Field names are matched case-insensitively.
- `list_of_values` (Boolean) True when the field accepts only the values listed below.
- `multivalued` (Boolean) True when the field holds several values, which cannot be compared with the ordering operators.
- `qualifier` (String) Scope the field belongs to.
- `searchable` (Boolean) True when the field may appear in a criteria.
- `sortable` (Boolean) True when the field may be used in a sort.
- `unit` (String) Unit for a numeric or timestamp field, such as the age unit for a relative time.
- `user_defined` (Boolean) True when the field was added for this tenant rather than shipped with the platform.
- `values` (Attributes List) The closed value set, present only for a list-of-values field. Use `display` in a criteria. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields--values))

<a id="nestedatt--fields--values"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields.values`

Read-Only:

- `display` (String) Value as written in a criteria.
- `internal` (Number) Value as stored.
- `synonyms` (List of String) Alternative spellings the API also accepts.
